title: Outpatient Physical Therapy

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.text: This synthetic policy identifies information used to prepare a service request for human review.

sections.heading: Coverage Criteria
sections.text:
- The record identifies a condition associated with measurable functional limitations.
- The plan of care contains measurable treatment goals.
- Continued-service requests describe objective progress or barriers to progress.

sections.heading: Required Documentation
sections.text:
- Diagnosis and functional limitations
- Initial assessment findings
- Frequency and duration of the proposed plan
- Measurable short-term and long-term goals
- Progress notes for continued-service requests

sections.heading: Limitations and Exceptions
sections.text:
- A paid therapy claim does not establish completion of a therapy course.
- Maintenance services may require separate benefit review.
- Benefits and visit limits must be checked independently.

sections.heading: Decision Boundary
sections.text: Meeting the listed criteria does not automatically approve the request. Eligibility, benefits, exclusions, clinical context and applicable requirements must be reviewed by an authorized human reviewer.

disclaimer: Synthetic policy created for software demonstration and evaluation. It is not medical or insurance guidance.
